results.finding: sections, unit counts and unit forms match the spec

All 69 aligned prose/list units summarize to the controlling idea of their aligned spec paragraph (p01-p69, including p51-p52 after Six Axes and p46 before p45) in spec order; the five callouts have no spec paragraph.
The reverse outliner marked no unit as holding two ideas.

Every unit ties to T1-T5 through its section's advances_thesis (scene T1; models and axes T2; asks T3; in-practice T4; register, trade-offs, failure modes, Chief Architect, questions T5); intro and conclusion units carry the thesis and hand-off.

Each table is framed by a sentence saying what it shows (ladder table and Figure 1 caption; axis table then per-axis paragraphs; vertical table 'Read down the endpoint column...'; consequences table and Figure 2; register 'Read across the rows and Noor's proposal shrinks'; trade-off table 'Two judgements follow from this table'); Figures 1-4 have explanatory captions; quotations are followed by what they show.

All declared transition_in boundaries (section and paragraph level, plus conclusion) express the declared relationship and pick up the carried-over item at the start of the unit, e.g. 'The model is therefore an architecture decision' (cause_effect), 'Ingrid did not argue with the slide' (contrast), 'Of the six axes defined earlier, the endpoint reaches furthest' (emphasis), 'The seven failures share a remedy' (problem_solution), 'The taxonomy tells a marketplace where its job ends. It does not tell it whether...' (contrast hand-off).

Opens on a puzzling scenario (five partly right answers), bridges to the claim and gives a roadmap; none of the weak patterns.
Conclusion maps the five answers onto register rows and hands off to liquidity; no new subtopic, no 'in conclusion', not a bare restated thesis.

States what no single section states (each opening answer is right for some register rows, so the disagreement becomes configuration) and why it matters (shared platforms sized by profile; moves reversed by changing a row, not a migration program).
Returns to the five people's five answers and assigns each to rows of the register, as callback.to declares.

Cold reader of the opening predicted all ten expected sections in order (Veldmark grid, four models, other axes/profile, verticals, what each model asks, documented moves, register, where to end, failure modes, Chief Architect's decisions and questions), the evidence (dated named-company records and fictional Veldmark) and a declarative, practical tone.

Cold reader named order, payment, payout, shipping, dispute and ledger contexts via a licensed PSP, KYC/trader identity and DAC7, the ranking signal moving to purchase; scoped per category to goods not cars or homes (leboncoin, Kleinanzeigen, Marktplaats), as configuration in the profile register, with an exit plan citing OLX's pull-back. Matches expected.
